name: Albino Foundry Crusher
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production static game enemy sprite, original project adaptation. Image 1: base anatomy and detailed raster style reference. Create ONE newly authored Albino Foundry Crusher in stable low quadrupedal idle. PROJECT_ADAPTATION systemic albino derivative of reviewed enemy-026-foundry-crusher, bounded by the broad anatomy visible in licensed Hiya Aliens: Colonial Marines Crusher product photography. Preserve one low, heavy four-legged siege Xenomorph with a large broad backward-swept head shield, small jaw beneath it, massively developed front limbs, lower smaller hindquarters and exactly one heavy articulated spear tail. The Albino modifier changes newly authored organic pigment/material response only: warm pearl, pale parchment and cool ash-gray chitin with restrained translucent rose-taupe recesses; shield edges remain chalk-ivory/aged bone while localized soot, brown heat tarnish and non-glowing mineral abrasions carry the project Foundry history. Never copy licensed or predecessor pixels and never reproduce red photo lighting or watermark. Strict RIGHT-facing orthographic gameplay profile across idle, move, discrete crest-bash attack, terminal death and a separate grounded acceleration/braking charge. No upright Warrior/Queen anatomy, horns, lava, machinery, copied pixels, official Albino model, canonExact or 1:1 claim.
Clearly show FOUR grounded limbs: large front pair and shorter hind pair, far feet subtly staggered. Broad swept head SHIELD, not a horn; small jaw beneath. Pale ivory shell with localized matte soot and brown heat-tarnish, no glowing effects. Complete single articulated spear tail extends behind left. ONE whole creature, strict orthographic RIGHT-facing profile. True transparent alpha with no floor/shadow/halo. Compose smaller within central 75% canvas, all silhouette at least 10% from edges. No sheet, grid, duplicates, text, logos, watermark, equipment, gore or crop. Single static pose only.

reference.visualNotes: Reviewed base sheet: low quadrupedal siege creature with broad swept head shield, large front limbs, smaller rear limbs and full heavy pointed tail.

review.notes: Low quadruped, leading shield rather than horn, four limbs (front feet partially overlap), one full tail, ivory/ash organic shell with localized matte soot verified. Native alpha and no crop; lateral padding 6.5-6.8%. Static adaptation only.
